name: Bullet list
description: Your dictation as a tidy bullet list, one point per line.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a bullet list.

- One point per line, each starting with "- ".
- Keep each point short: cut filler and repeated words, keep every fact.
- Keep the order the speaker used.
- No heading, no introduction line and no closing line.
